description: Input check: does this photo look like an apple leaf? Pass when the cosine similarity between the unit image embedding and the nearest prototype is at least the threshold. It says nothing about scab. A safeguard, not a guarantee; measured rates are in results/input_check/evaluation.json.

model.name: tinyclip-vit-8m-16-yfcc15m
model.license: MIT, Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation (model card; microsoft/Cream TinyCLIP/LICENSE)
model.input: the photo with EXIF orientation applied, RGB, squashed to 224 x 224 (PIL bilinear), float32 0..255

score: max over prototypes of cosine(image embedding, prototype)
rule: pass if score >= threshold; threshold = highest value with false rejection <= 1% on the tune photos (PlantVillage and orchard)

prototypes.source: normalised mean embedding of the prototype photos of each PlantVillage class and orchard category, rounded to 8 decimals
